consent.title: Connect {client} to your Maxina account
consent.lead: {client} would like to use your Maxina account. Choose what it may see. You can change or remove this at any time in Maxina.
consent.readOnly: Read-only: your assistant cannot post, send messages or change anything.
consent.notShared: Never shared: health data, Vitana Index, diary, memories and private messages.
consent.redirectsTo: After you allow it, you go back to {host}.
consent.failed: That did not work. Please try again.
consent.invalid: This request has expired or is not valid. Start the connection again in your AI assistant.

settings.title: Connected AI
settings.lead: Bring ChatGPT or Claude into your Maxina community. Your assistant reads only what you allow.
settings.step1Claude: In Claude, open Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector.
settings.step1Chatgpt: In ChatGPT, open Settings → Apps & Connectors → Create.
settings.step3: Sign in with your Maxina account and choose what your assistant may see.
settings.disconnectedNote: Disconnected: this assistant can no longer use Maxina. You can also remove it in ChatGPT or Claude.
settings.saveFailed: Could not save. Please try again.
settings.loadFailed: Your connected assistants could not be loaded.
settings.findableTitle: Let other members' AI assistants find me
settings.findableDesc: When on, members who connected ChatGPT or Claude can see your name, avatar, public city and interests. Off by default.
